program_name: Yamal (Sabetta) Arctic Integrated Emergency Rescue Center — MChS (opened May 2026)
program_type: National emergency search & rescue hub (MChS/FMBA/Marine Rescue Service)
key_benefits: Co-ordinated round-the-clock response to incidents in hard-to-reach Arctic areas incl. NSR; telemedicine, psychological support, radiation/chemical/biological safety; rapid deployment in extreme cold; joint MChS-FMBA duties for Arctic workers and crews.
eligibility: Federal/regional rescue & medical infrastructure serving the Arctic Zone & NSR; joint MChS/FMBA/Marine Rescue Service crews
operator: MChS (Ministry of Emergency Situations) + FMBA + Yamalo-Nenets administration
sources: news-pravda.com (Pravda EN: MES Minister Alexander Kurenkov opened center in Yamal w/ FMBA head Veronika Skvortsova & Yamal Governor Dmitry Artyukhov); usa.news-pravda.com world 2026-05-12 (FMBA: joint MChS-FMBA operations, 170+ telemedicine interventions); telegra.ph (MES-FMBA accord, medical unit Murmansk Pirogov Center). eligibility: Federal MChS/FMBA/Rosmorpeflot facilities; eastern NSR operations hub
operator: Federal State Institution 'Management of Capital Construction for MChS of Russia'; MChS/FMBA/Rosmorpeflot
sources: ulus-media / Uluus Media (4.07B RUB turnkey tender, MChS/FMBA/Rosmorpeflot, 19-bay garage, medical center, Mi-38 hangars/taxiways/2 helipads, est. 2026-2028); bellona.org (Tiksi construction to begin 2026); news-mail.ru (Tiksi slated as next after Pevek/Sabetta).
